answers.core: The change needs to be done to an existing editor plugin
answers.workaround:
No script needed. The workaround is to toggle "Editable Children" in the instanced child scene.
While the workaround is simple enough, it might require several nested "Editable Children" to be toggled in a more complex setup (i.e. a level scene that contains a "player start area scene" that contains a "player scene" that contains a "camera rig" that contains a Camera3D node)

title: Allow previewing Camera3D from instanced child scenes
